current_suggestion.pitch: She is a physicist who takes a skeptical, first-principles look at science news, including how research gets hyped and where studies and incentives go wrong. Your list is mostly health, poker, and AI voices, and she adds a more critical view of how to read new studies and AI claims, which fits your interest in clear thinking and inversion. She posts short solo explainers, usually 5-12 minutes and dense with data, several times a week.
